svg.aria-label: Varad Shajith, AI / research engineering, Nashik, CS '28. I build systems that refuse to lie to their users. A system that fails loudly is fixable. One that returns a confident, well-formed, wrong answer is not; you never know to look. Most of my work is making the second kind impossible.
